front_content.text:
模拟阅读材料：

Researchers first observed strong public enthusiasm for the platform. Yet a later follow-up found rapid disengagement once users realized most features were merely cosmetic.

任务：划去不能由材料支持的判断，保留有依据的判断。

back_content.text:
应划去：
follow-up 证明用户黏性持续增强。
cosmetic 说明功能深层优化已完成。
back_content.explanation: enthusiasm到rapid disengagement说明热度很快回落，不支持2的持续增强。merely cosmetic表示大多只改表面，不支持3的深层优化完成。1、4分别保留这两处意思。

analysis_content.text: enthusiasm到rapid disengagement说明热度很快回落，不支持2的持续增强。merely cosmetic表示大多只改表面，不支持3的深层优化完成。1、4分别保留这两处意思。
tips: 同时读时间变化initial/later与程度词merely，不把外表改动当功能改进。

follow-up 证明用户黏性持续增强。
cosmetic 说明功能深层优化已完成。
merely cosmetic 支持“表面化改动”判断。

back_content.explanation: university必须先获得当地伙伴配套支持，资金安排才会进行，所以contingent是取决于条件的，不是无条件保证。

analysis_content.text: university必须先获得当地伙伴配套支持，资金安排才会进行，所以contingent是取决于条件的，不是无条件保证。

阅读片段：

The mayor praised the initiative as ambitious. Still, civic groups called it performative, noting that no enforceable timeline or budget had been released.

任务：performative 在该语境下最可能表示什么？

back_content.text: 答案：C。symbolic in appearance but weak in execution
back_content.explanation: no enforceable timeline or budget说明没有可执行的时间与资金承诺，C的外表象征性、执行薄弱符合批评。不是经科学验证，也不是有法律约束；市长的ambitious评价来自另一方。

front_content.text:
练习材料（虚构情境）
阅读片段：

Initial media coverage framed the merger as transformative. Yet later performance audits characterized the integration outcomes as marginal and uneven across regions.

任务：划去不能由材料支持的判断，保留有依据的判断。

back_content.text: 应划去：The later audit confirmed that all regions had been transformed equally.；The later audit strengthened the initial claim without qualification.。
back_content.explanation: 后续审计用 marginal 和 uneven 限定效果，与先前 transformative 的表述形成对照。不能把这种修正理解成毫无保留的强化。

analysis_content.text: 后续审计用 marginal 和 uneven 限定效果，与先前 transformative 的表述形成对照。不能把这种修正理解成毫无保留的强化。
tips: 把 marginal 和 uneven 与 transformative 对照，检查后续审计是否支持最初的强评价。

eliminable_items.text: The later audit confirmed that all regions had been transformed equally.
Yet marks a contrast between early coverage and later evaluation.
Marginal and uneven describes limited results that differed across regions.
The later audit strengthened the initial claim without qualification.

front_content.text:
比较两组句子：
A. The system reduced errors in the pilot office. It has not been tested in larger offices.
B. Early publicity called the system reliable. Later checks found frequent failures.

A和B怎样影响对系统的评价？“未测试”是否就等于“已经证明无效”？

back_content.text: A限制适用证据范围，不能证明大办公室无效。B的频繁故障则质疑先前可靠的评价。
back_content.explanation: has not been tested表示缺少该场景证据，不是测试失败。frequent failures给出实际不可靠表现，才与早期评价冲突。后句带来未知、限制或反证，要读具体内容。

analysis_content.text: has not been tested表示缺少该场景证据，不是测试失败。frequent failures给出实际不可靠表现，才与早期评价冲突。后句带来未知、限制或反证，要读具体内容。
tips: 把“没有证据证明有效”与“已有证据显示无效”分开。

阅读片段：

The policy was initially described as equitable. In a subsequent distributional analysis, however, benefits were shown to be heavily concentrated among high-income households.

任务：后一句对最初的 equitable 评价起什么作用？

back_content.text: 答案：C。利益集中于高收入家庭，使最初的公平评价受到质疑
back_content.explanation: equitable仍表示公平；后句说利益heavily concentrated among high-income households，质疑的是此政策是否真公平，所以C正确。它没有把equitable一词改成“不公平”的词典含义。

analysis_content.text: equitable仍表示公平；后句说利益heavily concentrated among high-income households，质疑的是此政策是否真公平，所以C正确。它没有把equitable一词改成“不公平”的词典含义。
tips: 分清单词是什么意思，以及数据是否支持用它评价这个对象。

front_content.text:
练习材料（虚构情境）
阅读片段：

A preliminary survey suggested widespread trust in the platform. Even so, retention analytics later revealed steep monthly churn among first-time users.

任务：划去不能由材料支持的判断，保留有依据的判断。

back_content.text: 应划去：Steep monthly churn means nearly all first-time users stayed indefinitely.；The earlier trust survey guarantees stable long-term retention.。
back_content.explanation: churn 在此指用户流失，而不是留存；信任调查与后续行为指标不同。Even so 引出需要补充到原先判断中的限制。

analysis_content.text: churn 在此指用户流失，而不是留存；信任调查与后续行为指标不同。Even so 引出需要补充到原先判断中的限制。
tips: 分别核对信任调查与用户流失数据，别把 churn 误读为留存提高。

eliminable_items.text: The later retention findings introduce a qualification to the earlier positive picture.
Steep monthly churn means nearly all first-time users stayed indefinitely.
The earlier trust survey guarantees stable long-term retention.
The later data indicate substantial monthly loss of first-time users.

front_content.text:
练习材料（虚构情境）
The pilot survey described the service as reliable. A follow-up audit found that performance deteriorated sharply during peak demand.

任务：判断：The later audit qualifies the earlier positive assessment by identifying a situation in which performance worsened.

back_content.text: True。后续审计指出高峰需求下性能恶化，限制了最初可靠的评价。
back_content.explanation: peak demand是具体情景，deteriorated sharply是该情景的实际发现。这些内容才是修正理由，并非只因为审计时间较晚就一定更否定前文。

analysis_content.text: peak demand是具体情景，deteriorated sharply是该情景的实际发现。这些内容才是修正理由，并非只因为审计时间较晚就一定更否定前文。
tips: 看后续证据增加了什么条件或结果，不仅看later或follow-up字样。
